limitations: Windows process counters for the whole integrated test: in-process native clients and HTTPS server; PostgreSQL, child processes and OS filesystem cache excluded.
Private-byte sampling can miss peaks between observations; 50ms is the requested wait, not a real-time guarantee.
Debug build, repeated 1GiB content, warm caches; not a 4GiB aggregate measurement or proof of a universal memory bound.
Desktop MSI compilation ran concurrently; elapsed time is not a calibrated performance budget.
sampleIntervalDescription: 50ms requested wait; process-counter reads add overhead. Mean interval includes process startup and completion.
